Carboxylic acid Functional group –COOH General formula: CnH(2n+1) COOH General representation: RCOOH IUPAC name: Alkane-e+oic acid= Alkanoic acid Note: select the longest chain containing –COOH group as parent chain and counting of carbon is done from the nearest terminal of the –COOH group. The position of –COOH group is indicated by Arabic numerals before the suffix –oic acid. If two or three –COOH groups are present in the same molecule, dioic or trioic is written along with their position. Example:
Common Name Formic acid Acetic acid Propanoic acid Butyric acid Oxalic acid
IUPAC Name Methanoic acid Ethanoic acid Propanoic acid Butanoic acid Ethan-1,2-dioic acid
Ether Functional group –OGeneral formula CnH(2n+2)O General representation: ROR’ IUPAC name: Alkoxy+alkane= Alkoxy alkane

Note: select the longest chain containing –O- group as parent chain and counting of carbon is done from the nearest terminal of the –O- group. The position of –OH group is indicated by Arabic numerals before the suffix –ol. If two or three –OH groups are present in the same molecule diol or triol is written along with their position. Example:
Common Name Dimethyl ether Ethyl methyl ether Diethyl ether Isopropyl methyl ether
IUPAC Name Methoxy methane Methoxy ethane Ethoxy ethane 2-methoxy propane
Functional group: General formula CnH(2n)O2 General representation: ROH IUPAC name: Alkyl alkane-e+oate= Alkyl alkanoate
